name: symfony/dom-crawler
reason: Crawler loads XML with DOMDocument::loadXML; libxml2 family wrapper, and a navigation tool rather than its own parser.

name: jms/serializer
reason: Typed serializer; XML deserialization calls simplexml_load_string / DOMDocument (libxml2 family). Serializers are outside the XML cell protocol.

name: sabre/xml
reason: Sabre\Xml\Reader extends PHP's XMLReader; shares the verified libxml2 family and is not an independent parser engine.

name: veewee/xml
reason: Functional wrappers over Dom\XMLDocument, DOMDocument::loadXML and XMLReader::fromString; libxml2 family.

name: mtownsend/xml-to-array
reason: Converts XML to arrays through DOMDocument::loadXML; libxml2 family.

name: saloonphp/xml-wrangler
reason: Requires veewee/xml for reading; libxml2 family through that wrapper.

name: prewk/xml-string-streamer
reason: Own byte-level StringWalker/UniqueNode splitter over streams that yields raw node strings (typically handed to SimpleXML); it does no namespace resolution or entity/CDATA decoding of its own. Not a complete XML parser under the cell protocol; no control run.

name: laravie/parser
reason: Document reader built on simplexml_load_string / simplexml_load_file; libxml2 family.

name: orchestra/parser
reason: Laravel bridge that requires laravie/parser; libxml2 family through SimpleXML.

name: pear/xml_parser
reason: SAX wrapper over xml_parser_create (PHP ext/xml, libxml2-based); not an independent engine.

name: watoki/dom
reason: Own pure-PHP finite-state markup parser (src/watoki/dom/fsm, last release 2016). Source has no namespace resolution, CDATA or entity/character-reference decoding, so it is not shown to be XML-format-aware under this protocol; no control run.

name: arc/xml
reason: Ariadne arc\xml\Parser builds on SimpleXMLElement/DOM; libxml2 family.
